chains.title: 霍尔木兹关闭 → 台湾的原油与天然气
chains.title_en: Hormuz closure → Taiwan's crude and gas
chains.summary: 海峡关闭半年，台湾没有断油断气；多付的钱主要由国库承担，消费者只付了一小部分，冲击落在把石油天然气当原料的行业。
chains.summary_en: Six months into the closure Taiwan ran short of neither oil nor gas; the extra cost was carried mostly by the treasury, consumers paid a small part, and the shock fell on industries that use oil and gas as feedstock.

turning_point.text: 中油增资 73.53 亿美元一案，2026-09-04 被两个党团扬言全数删除；删掉则成本转向中油资产负债表之外
turning_point.text_en: The US$7.354 billion capital injection into CPC was threatened with deletion by two caucuses on 4 September 2026; if cut, the cost moves off CPC's balance sheet to somewhere not yet observed
turning_point.source: analysis/台湾-进口支出增额与承担结构-2026-09-19.md

chains.title: 霍尔木兹关闭 → 欧盟的原油与天然气
chains.title_en: Hormuz closure → EU crude and gas
chains.summary: 欧盟换掉了海峡以内的供应，多付的钱大部分按市场价落在消费者与企业身上，政府只补了两到三成；制造业没有出现台湾那样的原料行业减产。
chains.summary_en: The EU replaced supply from inside the strait; most of the extra cost reached consumers and firms through market prices and governments covered only a fifth to a quarter or so; manufacturing showed none of Taiwan's feedstock-industry cuts.

turning_point.text: 政府拨款占进口增额 22.9%–28.3%，离财政约束还远；折点更可能出现在家庭与运输企业一侧
turning_point.text_en: Government support equals 22.9–28.3% of the extra import bill, far from a fiscal limit; a turning point is more likely on the side of households and transport firms

loop.head_en: Europe's replacement cargoes came north via the Red Sea and Suez, and those tolls went to Egypt

chains.title: 霍尔木兹关闭与以色列断气 → 埃及
chains.title_en: Hormuz closure and Israeli gas cut-off → Egypt
chains.summary: 原定要找一个付不起的国家，埃及这一次付得起：燃料一次调价、埃镑贬值一成半，把代价摊给了所有人；外汇缺口由基金组织拨款、战前的套期保值与长期合同、以及因霍尔木兹关闭而增加的运河收入补上。
chains.summary_en: This was meant to be a country that could not pay; this time Egypt could. A one-off fuel price rise and a 15% fall of the pound spread the cost over everyone; the foreign-currency gap was filled by IMF money, pre-war hedges and long-term contracts, and extra canal revenue caused by the Hormuz closure itself.

turning_point.text: 8 月储备创新高全靠金价，外币持有当月减少 11.58 亿美元；外币持有继续下降是最先要看的约束
turning_point.text_en: August's record reserves came entirely from gold; currency holdings fell US$1.158 billion that month, and a continued fall there is the first constraint to watch

s1.head: 战前签下的原油套期保值与长期天然气合同起了作用
s1.head_en: Oil hedges and long-term gas contracts signed before the war did their work

figures.note_en: The press release says the shock was cushioned by remittances tourism the Suez recovery oil hedging contracts and long-term gas agreements

s2.head: 以色列管道气 2 月 28 日起中断
s2.head_en: Israeli pipeline gas stopped from 28 February

figures.note_en: From 28 February 2026 Israel shut the Leviathan and Karish fields and kept Tamar for its own market; exports to Egypt and Jordan stopped; restart date not found

s3.head: 能源进口每月由 5.6 亿美元升到 16.5 亿
s3.head_en: Energy imports rose from US$560 million to US$1.65 billion a month

chains.title: 霍尔木兹关闭 → 伊拉克
chains.summary: 出口几乎全部在海峡以内、北部管道扩不上去、没有预算也没有大额主权基金，封锁不到五个月就发不出工资；这是项目要找的付不起的案例。
chains.summary_en: With almost all exports inside the strait, a northern pipeline that could not be expanded, no budget and no large sovereign fund, Iraq could not pay salaries within five months; this is the case of a country that cannot pay that the project was looking for.

turning_point.text: 已过折点：7 月工资大量未发，议员呼吁央行增发货币；下一步看是否转为印钞或向海湾国家求援
turning_point.text_en: Past the turning point: many July salaries unpaid and a lawmaker urging central bank money creation; next watch whether this turns into money printing or a request for Gulf support

loop.head: 9 月袭击沙特东西管道的无人机，从伊拉克迈桑省起飞
loop.head_en: The drones that hit Saudi Arabia's East–West pipeline in September took off from Maysan province in Iraq

figures.label: 东西管道遇袭关闭
figures.value: 关闭前输量 400 万至 500 万桶/日
figures.value_en: 4–5 million bbl per day before closure
figures.note: 无人机自伊拉克迈桑省起飞，无人认领；4 月曾受损、三天内恢复；布伦特油价升到 104 美元以上；分析师本·卡希尔在同一篇报道里说，撑过前六个月的那些缓冲已经基本耗尽
figures.note_en: Drones launched from Maysan province in Iraq; unclaimed; the pipeline was damaged in April and restored within three days; Brent above US$104; in the same report analyst Ben Cahill said the key buffers that got the market through the first six months had been worn away

chains.title: 霍尔木兹关闭 → 海湾产油国的绕行通道
chains.title_en: Hormuz closure → the Gulf producers' bypass routes
chains.summary: 沙特经红海延布、阿联酋经富查伊拉、阿曼本来就在海峡以外，封锁初期靠高油价多收；但这些通道接连遭到袭击，9 月东西管道关闭，绕行本身成了下一轮攻击的目标。
chains.summary_en: Saudi Arabia via Yanbu on the Red Sea, the UAE via Fujairah and Oman, already outside the strait, earned more from high prices early on; but these routes were attacked one after another, the East–West pipeline shut in September, and the bypass itself became the next target.

turning_point.text: 9 月 10 至 11 日东西管道关闭，关闭前输量 400 万至 500 万桶/日；延布储油只够五到七天出口
turning_point.text_en: The East–West pipeline shut on 10–11 September after carrying 4–5 million bbl per day; Yanbu storage covers five to seven days of exports

s1.head: 阿联酋第二条绕行管道 5 月建成一半
s1.head_en: The UAE's second bypass pipeline was half built in May

figures.label: 第二条绕行管道
figures.note: 建成后富查伊拉出口能力翻倍
figures.note_en: Would double export capacity through Fujairah

s2.head: 海峡以内的沙特码头出口归零，红海延布是封锁前的 2.4 到 5.7 倍

chains.title: 俄方袭击 → 欧洲援乌武器供应链

chains.summary: 袭击对象从铁路与包裹转向为乌克兰生产的军工厂和空运枢纽；公开材料只量得到第二段，交付受没受影响、代价由谁承担，多数还没有数。
chains.summary_en: Targets have moved from rail and parcels to plants producing for Ukraine and to an air-cargo hub; public material measures only the disruption stage, and whether deliveries suffered or who bore the cost is mostly unmeasured.

turning_point.text: 德国 9 月 1 日把威胁等级由一般升为高，并关闭俄驻波恩领事馆；下一步看北约是否把这类袭击纳入集体防御的讨论
turning_point.text_en: On 1 September Germany raised the threat level from general to high and closed the Russian consulate in Bonn; next watch whether NATO brings such attacks into collective-defence discussion

s1.gap_en: To measure: national counter-sabotage budgets, defence-firm security spending, insurance premiums; candidate sources are the German federal budget line for the BfV and listed defence firms' annual reports

links.zh: 同一次海峡关闭；两地都证实能否替代看装运港在海峡内外
links.en: The same closure; both show that substitutability depends on whether the loading port is inside the strait

links.zh: 同一场战争：海峡关闭与以色列关停气田同在 2 月 28 日
links.en: The same war: the strait closure and Israel's field shutdown both date from 28 February

links.zh: 同一个世界油价：两地原油进口单价同时在四五月见顶
links.en: One world oil price: crude import unit values peaked in April–May in both

links.zh: 对照：美国原油在欧洲成了替代（3–6 月 +41.5%），在台湾没有（−1.6%）
links.en: Contrast: US crude became the substitute in Europe (+41.5% in March–June) but not in Taiwan (−1.6%)

links.zh: 对照：台湾国库承担多于进口增额，欧洲政府只补了两到三成
links.en: Contrast: Taiwan's treasury absorbed more than the import increase; European governments covered a fifth to a quarter or so

links.zh: 对照：台湾原料行业减产 8%–11%，欧洲化工业没有减产；「行政定价把经济按原料与能源分成两半」这条猜想，在市场定价的欧洲找不到对应的分界
links.en: Contrast: Taiwan's feedstock industries fell 8–11%, European chemicals did not; the conjecture that administered pricing splits an economy between feedstock and energy users finds no matching divide in market-priced Europe

links.zh: 欧洲的替代货走红海与苏伊士，运河收入 7 月同比 +42%
links.en: Europe's replacement cargoes used the Red Sea and Suez; canal revenue +42% y/y in July

links.zh: 抵消但远不够：运河每月多一亿多美元，能源进口每月多约十一亿
links.en: An offset but far from enough: canal revenue up about US$0.1–0.15 billion a month against about US$1.1 billion more for energy imports

links.zh: 油价上涨与对俄制裁松动（枚举表第 27 条）抬高俄方收入
links.en: Higher oil prices and loosened sanctions on Russia (enumeration table no. 27) raise Russian revenue

links.zh: 出口一侧的实测印证进口一侧的发现：海峡以内的码头停摆，海峡以外的延布、阿曼增加
links.en: Export-side measurements match the import-side finding: terminals inside the strait stopped while Yanbu and Oman rose

links.zh: 9 月东西管道关闭，欧洲经延布与苏伊士北上的沙特原油来源中断
links.en: The East–West pipeline closure in September cuts off the Saudi crude that reached Europe via Yanbu and Suez

links.zh: 延布的原油改经苏伊士运河和苏伊士—地中海管道北上，西迪克里尔码头 8 月出口是封锁前的 3.6 倍
links.en: Yanbu crude went north via the Suez Canal and the Suez–Mediterranean pipeline; Sidi Kerir exported 3.6 times its pre-closure level in August

links.zh: 对照：埃及靠基金组织、战前合同和运河收入付得起，伊拉克没有绕行通道也没有缓冲，发不出工资
links.en: Contrast: Egypt could pay with IMF money, pre-war contracts and canal revenue; Iraq had neither a bypass nor buffers and could not pay salaries

links.zh: 袭击沙特东西管道的无人机从伊拉克迈桑省起飞
links.en: The drones that hit the Saudi East–West pipeline took off from Maysan province in Iraq

links.zh: 同一批欧洲国家同时承受能源代价与境内袭击
links.en: The same European states carry the energy cost and attacks on their own soil
